caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of fabric with scalloped edges outlined in light blue. The fabric itself has a light, beige color with a woven texture. Inside the border, there is a repeating pattern of small, blue circular holes evenly spaced along the edges. The central area features an arrangement of embroidered pink flowers with green leaves, connected by a wavy blue ribbon-like element that flows horizontally across the middle. The name "Frank J. Nelson" is inscribed in the lower right corner of the drawing. The overall composition is centered on a plain, off-white background.
title: Pin Cushion Doily
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
